semantic.justification: Consumed area-listening,broadcast,tracking and recalculation methods run on the same actual ScDocument. Literal private-member access bridges TypeScript class-file boundaries without a second state model. SetAllFormulasDirty retains its existing document.cxx responsibility. Block73 extends the prior bounded slices with native local/ODFF rectangular and whole-axis double references,shared RangeLine compilation,default scalar intersection,range aggregate execution over actual typed stores,and ordinary area-slot dependency ownership. Native logarithmic slot geometry,shared identity,bulk/deferred erasure,reference-update chaining,sheet shifts and semantic destruction are consumed without individual-cell listener expansion. ScValueIterator and RangeColumnSpanSet use actual document/column stores;portable array accumulation retains original four-stream Kahan order. Typed double out-references preserve encoded NaN payload storage. Earlier exclusions of these specific services are superseded here. Group/3D/external/named-reference expressions,matrix evaluation,nondefault subtotal/text-zero and number-format services remain unsupported;broader parity remains unverified. CALC250-252 record retained upstream edge behavior and limits on numerical evidence. Block74 work in progress connects actual RPN outer-function adjacency,directional AutoSum search with the original20-cell cutoff,sum-of-sums,relative range token output,and nonempty selected-block totals through native SetFormulaOperation. Original StartFormula preserves content-dependent UTF16 selection instead of replacing every cell with a bare equals;browser caret projection runs after controlled render and retains shared Writer styling. NeedHeight queries traverse actual attribute runs and default-column tails. The normal enabled-recording/default-view profile retains real value owners and source manual-calculation behavior. Clipboard EnterBlock/PasteFromClip,grouped formula copies,named database/autofilter collections,SUBTOTAL,nondefault undo/alternate-view/device services remain unported. Browser availability disables contexts requiring those missing services;there is no flat-copy/alternate-evaluator substitute. Broad contract/default/behavior parity remains unverified and the task is not complete.
